name: sdd:plan-template: the generated plan keeps its structure
prompt: Invoke the sdd:plan-template skill, then write an implementation plan for adding an audit trail to this service at .specs/docs/plans/2026-09-10-audit-trail.md. Follow the template. Write the file and stop; you do not need to print it.

graders.why: a plan organises work into phases; that is what distinguishes it from a task
a dated log is what tells a human where the work stands later
the rules forbid agent instructions inside planning documents
